name: Goodlyfe Infused Pre-Roll | 24K Punch
description: 24k Gold Punch is a sativa dominant hybrid strain with a powerful scent and a flavor to match. This strain has an aroma of sweetness, coconut, and tropical fruit — with a similar flavor profile along with hints of grapefruit, citrus and fruit punch. 24k Gold Punch will allow you to relax while also uplifting you and keeping you in a happy mood. Its dominant terpenes include D-Limonene, ß-caryophyllene, and Myrcene.
